articles.description: AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign.

articles.headline: 10-man Bournemouth beat Celta Vigo to top Europa League
articles.description: Bournemouth moved a step closer to automatic qualification for the Europa League round of 16 after coming from behind with 10 men to win 2-1 at Celta Vigo.

articles.headline: Christian Pulisic comes off bench to spark Milan win over Olympiacos
articles.description: Christian Pulisic enjoyed a Thanksgiving to remember as the United States star came off the bench to help spark AC Milan's comeback win at Olympiacos.

images.name: Pulisic celeb Milan [1296x729]
images.caption: Christian Pulisic celebrates scoring Milan's winner against Olympiacos.
images.alt: Christian Pulisic of AC Milan celebrates with team-mates after scoring the goal during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD5 match between Olympiacos FC and AC Milan at Stadio Georgios Karaiskakis on November 26, 2026 in Piraeus, Greece
images.credit: Giuseppe Cottini/AC Milan via Getty Images

articles.headline: 'No excuses': Ruben Amorim slams team, questions himself after shock Milan loss
articles.description: AC Milan coach Ruben Amorim questioned himself and hit out at his team after a shock 2-0 home loss to Hungarian side Ferencvaros on Thursday.

articles.headline: Sunderland slump continues with home loss to Dinamo Zagreb
articles.description: Sunderland's unbeaten run in the Europa League came to an end as they were beaten 2-0 by Dinamo Zagreb at the Stadium of Light.

images.caption: Granit Xhaka and Sunderland feel to defeat against Dinamo Zagreb.
images.alt: Granit Xhaka of Sunderland reacts during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 match between Sunderland AFC and GNK Dinamo at Stadium of Light on November 5, 2026 in Sunderland, United Kingdom.
